name: Teikoku Kaleido -Banka no Kakumei-
original_name: 帝國カレイド―万華の革命―
source:
Our heroine, Kousaka Amane, was living a simple yet happy life in the countryside until one day she was suddenly taken away to live in the empire, summoned by her brother Amazaki Soushi -- the current ruler. Though she was unaware of the underlying circumstances, she finds herself brought to this lively and palpable central city.

Living in the immaculate royal palace, our heroine comes to learn that the empire might not be as joyful as it seems. 
Her brother is no longer the gentle man she once knew...
A corrupt organization secretly runs things behind the scenes...
The heroine’s fate guides her down the path of love.

[Edited from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
女主角高坂天音原本在乡下过着简单幸福生活，某天突然被召入帝国，与现任统治者、哥哥天崎宗司共同生活。她不知道背后原因，却被带入热闹鲜活的帝都。

住进一尘不染的皇宫后，女主角发现帝国也许不像表面那样快乐。哥哥已不再是记忆中温柔的人……腐败组织在幕后秘密操控一切……女主角的命运引导她走上恋爱之路。

[改编自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/505090/]Steam[/url]]
